content.short: Native USDC for Cosmos is minted on Noble, an appchain built for issuing stablecoins and real-world assets.
content.description: Noble was built for one job: issuing digital dollars and tokenized assets that move freely across the Cosmos ecosystem. It is where native USDC is minted for IBC chains. Noble also issues USDN, a dollar token whose yield comes from short-term US Treasury bills, and carries USDY, EURe, USYC and FRAX. Paradigm and Polychain are among its backers. The chain is run by NASD Inc., and the Noble Dollar is now its headline product for holders who want a yield-bearing dollar.
content.meta: Cosmos chain issuing native USDC for IBC plus USDN, a Treasury-backed yield dollar. Explore Noble on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
